result.title: Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding
result.summary: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「多样化 3D 可供性定位」任务，要求对同一物体与交互查询预测多个合理区域，并给出基于 transformer 的集合预测模型 Div3DAffordNet，以及用 2D 生成模型加 3D 重建自动合成、辅以轻量人工核验的数据构建流程和 Div3DAfford benchmark。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多假设集合预测与「一张输入对应多个可能区域」的建模方式，可能与 LVR 中维持多种 latent 假设、以及用视觉证据在候选间筛选的问题形成概念类比，但任务本身属 3D 交互定位，是否可迁移需核查。
